welcomeBody: Build a small, capable AI crew from the tools you already use. Keep your best models for the work that needs them.
welcomeNote: Five simple steps. Every change is yours to review.
privacy: Your work stays yours. No telemetry. No quota tracking.
refreshConsent: Keep model data up to date
consentBody: Allows a request to Artificial Analysis when you choose Refresh. No project content is sent. Cached for 24 hours. Turn this off any time.
crewPreview: A role for every kind of work
toolsBody: Choose your tools and subscription plans. Uncheck any models you cannot access. Access and capacity are estimates.
selectRequired: Choose a tool and at least one model to continue.
exportTip: This tool has no verified global file. You can copy its rules after review.
styleBody: Decide how your crew balances quality and available capacity.
balancedBody: Great work, with room to spare.
qualityBody: Give demanding work your strongest models.
orchestratorBody: Keeps work moving and hands tasks to the right model.
architectBody: Turns complex requests into a clear, testable plan.
builderBody: Writes and fixes code, then checks it works.
reviewerBody: Checks the work with a fresh, independent perspective.
automatorBody: Runs tools, tests and repeatable workflows.
workerBody: Handles summaries, docs and well-defined small tasks.
orchestratorTip: The orchestrator dispatches tasks and tracks progress. It does not make design decisions.
crewBody: Six clear responsibilities. Change a choice or lock it in before moving on.
effortTip: How much reasoning a model uses. Higher effort can take more time and capacity.
fallbackTip: Ordered alternatives when the first model is unavailable.
whySummary: Selected for this responsibility, your profile and available capacity.
familyWarning: Review the plan warnings before applying. Independent model families may be unavailable.
applyTitle: A clear change. A way back.
applyBody: Choose where to apply your crew. Review the exact changes first.
whatBody: Only Ensemble’s marked sections will change. Originals are backed up, writes are checked, and you can revert this session’s apply. Other content stays in place.
diffTip: A diff compares the file before and after. Plus lines are added, minus lines are removed.
sandbox: Development sandbox — your real home is untouched.
success: Changes applied and verified. Your backups are ready if you need them.
reverted: Changes reverted. Your original files are restored.
unchanged: Everything is already up to date.
toolSkipped: skipped: no global rules file, copy its rules manually.
toolCheckFailed: Some tools could not be verified. Check the rows below; your backups are ready.
summaryBody: A deliberate plan for the tools you own.
noWrites: Nothing changes until you click Apply.
refreshDone: Fresh data is ready for review.
keyHint: Encrypted in memory using your OS. Session only; never exported or saved as text. Leave blank to use public pages.
jsonTip: JSON is a portable text format. Paste an Ensemble access configuration below. Exports use your clipboard.
provisionalTip: Provisional means access is not yet verified. Select only tools where you have actually used this model.
noPlanDiff: No role assignments changed. Benchmark data may have changed.
refreshWhy: Recalculated using refreshed measurements and confirmed access.
error: That did not work. Check your selections and try again. No unreviewed changes were applied.
bridgeMissing: Open Ensemble in the desktop app to get started.
keyError: Secure storage or the service is unavailable. Your key was not saved as text.
refreshNeedsPlan: Choose your tools first to compare an updated plan.
reasonEffort: The {effort} effort uses its published catalog measurements.
reasonAudit: A different model family must audit this decision before acceptance.
warningFamilies: Independent review is unavailable with the eligible model families.
warningUnclassified: A new model family has not been verified. Independent review cannot be guaranteed.
warningMinimum: No available model meets this role’s minimum benchmark. The closest option is used.
warningEffort: Only one reasoning level is measured. The benefit of a higher level is unknown.
reasonGeneric: Review this selection against your actual model access.
fileConflict: A file changed after preview. Review a fresh preview; your edits will be preserved.
roleConflict: Choose different model families for the builder and reviewer, or unlock one of those roles.
invalidJson: This is not a valid Ensemble plan configuration. Check the JSON and try again.
exportHint: Exports copy text to your clipboard. Save it as AGENTS.md or a JSON file wherever you need it.
reasonOrchestrator: Coordinates instructions quickly at the lowest qualifying cost, considering cache price and response efficiency.
reasonArchitect: Balances knowledge accuracy and intelligence; a different family audits the decision.
reasonBuilder: Uses measured coding performance per scarce quota, with automated gates.
reasonReviewer: Balances low hallucination with knowledge accuracy and reviews a different family.
reasonAutomator: Uses automation benchmarks to choose reliable tool use from abundant pools.
reasonWorker: Keeps gated routine work on the cheapest available abundant pool, without very high effort.
reasonSaver: Uses the lowest passing effort and protects scarce quota.
reasonBalanced: Uses normal operating efforts and saves scarce Claude quota for difficult decisions.
reasonQuality: Prioritizes architecture knowledge, intelligence and stronger coding, with independent audit.
reasonProxy: The {effort} effort has gated operational evidence only. Benchmarks from {reference} effort are a model-level estimate; this effort has no published benchmark scores.
reasonReplan: Choose a reviewer from a different family before switching to this builder fallback.
warningAbundance: No abundant pool is available for this role. The cheapest qualifying accessible option uses limited subscription quota.
warningProxy: This effort has operational evidence only; its benchmark scores are unavailable. Treat the other effort’s model-level estimate with caution.
recoveryBody: Restore files from a previous apply. Files edited since then are protected.
recoveryRequired: Apply could not finish. Use Revert below to recover previous changes.
hardlinkWarning: A target has hard links. Applying replaces this file independently; other linked copies keep their previous content.
applyRolledBack: Apply failed. Previous files were restored.
updateConsentBody: Checks GitHub releases at startup and every 6 hours, downloads supported updates in the background, and never restarts without your click; no telemetry.
updateIdle: Updates have not been checked yet.
updateDev: Updates are available only in the installed app.
updateError: Could not check or install the update. Try again or download from GitHub.
updateBannerReady: Update ready: version {version}. Restart to update
updateBannerAvailable: New version available: {version}. Download to update.
